comparison.objective: Unscrew a flashlight cap, tip out its battery, and set parts down, versus tune and lock a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: This shares bimanual counterholding, rotary loosening, regrasping, and controlled part handling, but lacks hex-key insertion, collar calibration, and response-guided iteration.
comparison.success_condition: Requires cap removal and safe battery/part placement; candidate requires relocking and two repeatable non-bottoming impacts with rebound, overload, and drift limits.
comparison.reason: The shared rotary primitives are substantial but serve a different tested ability and terminal outcome.
